# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Your playlists

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com

Playlists and favorites owned by the authenticated user. All endpoints require a bearer token unless noted.

### `DELETE /api/playlist/{id}` — Delete a playlist

Auth: `Bearer` or `GuestId`

Deletes a playlist. Only the owner (user or guest) can delete it.

**Requires a bearer token or an `X-Guest-Id` header.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | `string` | yes |  |

Response `200` OK

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `GET /api/user/playlists` — List the user's playlists

Auth: `Bearer`

Returns all playlists owned by the authenticated user.

**Requires a bearer token.**

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  name: string | null
  description: string | null
  createdBy: string | null
  updatedBy: string | null
  media: {
    id: string | null
    fileName: string | null
    contentType: string | null
    description: string | null
    isAnimated: bool
    credit: string | null
    cloudflareId: string | null
    mediaStorageType: int  // Possible values: `0` = Blob, `1` = Cloudflare, `2` = Badge
    absolutePath: string | null
    artist: {
      id: string | null
      name: string | null
      socialLink: string | null
      userId: string | null
      arts: object[] | null
    }
    upvotes: int
    tagString: string | null
    mediaTag: int  // Possible values: `0` = Neuro, `1` = Evil, `2` = Twins, `3` = Hiyori
  }
  createdAt: date-time | null
  updatedAt: date-time | null
  totalDuration: int | null
  songCount: int | null
  playCount: int | null
  favoriteCount: int | null
  playlistType: int  // Possible values: `0` = Setlist, `1` = Public, `2` = Private, `3` = Featured
  songListDTOs: {
    id: string | null
    title: string | null
    opus: string | null
    oss: string | null
    cnPath: string | null
    absolutePath: string | null
    playCount: int | null
    duration: int | null
    streamDate: date-time | null
    dateAdded: date-time | null
    coverArtists: string[] | null
    originalArtists: string[] | null
    genres: string[] | null
    coverArt: { …same as `media` above }
    thumbnailArt: { …same as `media` above }
    order: int
    hasLyrics: bool
    userUploaded: bool
    videoId: string | null
    hls: string | null
  }[] | null
  mosaicMedia: { …same as `media` above }[] | null
  genres: string[] | null
  editable: bool
  deletable: bool
  isPublic: bool
  isSetList: bool
  setListDate: date-time | null
}[]
```

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `POST /api/playlist/save` — Create or update a playlist

Auth: `Bearer` or `GuestId`

Creates a playlist when no ID is supplied, or updates the caller's playlist when an ID is supplied. Returns the playlist ID. Public playlists require a bearer token. Private playlists can also be created with a guest ID.

**Requires a bearer token or an `X-Guest-Id` header.**

Request body `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  name: string | null
  description: string | null
  createdBy: string | null
  mediaListDTO: {
    id: string | null
    fileName: string | null
    contentType: string | null
    description: string | null
    isAnimated: bool
    credit: string | null
    cloudflareId: string | null
    mediaStorageType: int  // Possible values: `0` = Blob, `1` = Cloudflare, `2` = Badge
    absolutePath: string | null
    artist: {
      id: string | null
      name: string | null
      socialLink: string | null
      userId: string | null
      arts: object[] | null
    }
    upvotes: int
    tagString: string | null
    mediaTag: int  // Possible values: `0` = Neuro, `1` = Evil, `2` = Twins, `3` = Hiyori
  }
  songId: string | null
  userAudioId: string | null
  isPublic: bool
  isSetList: bool
  setListDate: date-time | null
}
```

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
string
```

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `PUT /api/user/playlists/{playlistId}` — Add a song to a playlist

Auth: `Bearer`

Adds the song given by the `songId` query parameter to the playlist.

**Requires a bearer token.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `playlistId` | path | `string` | yes |  |
| `songId` | query | `string` | no |  |

Response `200` OK

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `PUT /api/user/playlists/{playlistId}/add-songs` — Add songs to a playlist

Auth: `Bearer`

Adds multiple songs to the playlist. The request body is a JSON array of song IDs.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `playlistId` | path | `string` | yes |  |

string[]

Response `200` OK

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `PUT /api/user/playlists/{playlistId}/add-user-song` — Add an uploaded song to a playlist

Auth: `Bearer`

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `songId` | query | `string` | no |  |

Response `200` OK

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `POST /api/user/playlists/{playlistId}/save-order` — Reorder a playlist

Auth: `Bearer`

Updates song positions in the playlist. Songs not included in the request keep their current position.

**Requires a bearer token.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `playlistId` | path | `string` | yes |  |

Request body `application/json`:

```ts
{
  songId: string | null
  userAudioId: string | null
  order: int
  oldOrder: int
  newOrder: int
}[]
```

Response `200` OK

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `GET /api/user/suggestions` — Get song suggestions

Auth: `Bearer`

Returns recommended songs based on the user's listening history. `take` sets the number of results, from 1 to 100 (default 100). Values above 100 are capped at 100.

**Requires a bearer token.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `take` | query | `int` | no |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:
